fields.headline: Extends the Alameda County Probation Department mentoring agreement to September 2023 with no new funding
fields.summary: This amendment to a memorandum of understanding (MOU) extends the Cross-Age Mentoring Program, in which high school students mentor middle school students, to September 30, 2023. The program serves Oakland High, Westlake Middle and Roosevelt Middle. The $390,000 from the Alameda County Probation Department is the existing total grant for the agreement; the attachment says this extension adds no money.

21-3107.note: This item was first shown as bringing in $390,000. The attached amendment and the county's letter show the $390,000 is the existing grant and this extension adds no new money.
21-3107.sourceIssue: The text states that the Probation Department funds $390,000 but does not say whether that amount is new with this amendment or covers the whole agreement; the attachment shows it is the existing total grant and the extension adds no money.
